# Course Home

This course begins with an introduction to reseach design and causality, then unpackages three research designs used for causal inference in empirical economics and finance:

1. Identification, Causality, and Identification Strategies
2. Difference-in-Differences (DiD)
3. Instrumental Variables (IV)
4. Regression Discontinuity (RD)

The emphasis is on connecting an economic question to a credible comparison, stating the identifying assumptions, implementing the estimator, and presenting diagnostics that make the design auditable.
